title: Open Logic Project — Türkçe Tam Sürüm / Complete Turkish Edition (OLP-0722, 722/722)
description:
Complete Turkish edition: all 722/722 frozen Open Logic Project content modules are translated. The 1,037-page linked reader covers the 642 canonical-reader-reachable modules; 80 retained non-reader modules remain in the editable corpus and are explicitly outside build/render applicability. Frozen authority: commit 9620cc73f9c8e0ad003c514a5d3748f29611c4c0, tree f67757bb9305b173634082ab4cefd5601a707a34, under CC BY 4.0.

All 722 targets passed aggregate exact-source, structural, and model-review admission. The 642 reader-reachable targets additionally passed a deterministic build with exit code 0 and zero missing-character or unresolved-reference/citation diagnostics, complete text-layer residue scans, and all-page visual inspection; build/render are not applicable to the 80 retained non-reader targets. The editable-source and evidence packages preserve terminology, translation decisions, source-backed emendations, build/render receipts, target hashes, closure records, DOI methodology, and Turkic interlanguage research notes.

Exact release DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21927145. Stable Turkish concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21921844.

Performed at Floris’s direction by “OpenAI 5.6 Sol, Ultra mode” (“OpenAI’s current flagship model for complex work”). Human or native review is not a release gate.
